gloss: to be able to, to be possible

definitions.explanation: Expresses ability or possibility. Often used with nouns or the potential meaning of verbs.

definitions.gloss: to be completed, to be made
definitions.explanation: For something to come into existence or be finished.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}ができますか？

examples.notes: V dict + ことができる

examples.japanese: ここで{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}ることができますか？
{彼|かれ}は{英語|えいご}も{中国語|ちゅうごくご}もできるので、{仕事|しごと}で{役|やく}に{立|た}っています。
examples.english: He can speak both English and Chinese, so he's useful at work.

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}ができました。
{駅|えき}の{前|まえ}に{新|あたら}しい{店|みせ}ができました。
examples.english: A new shop opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: この{机|つくえ}は{木|き}でできています。
examples.english: This desk is made of wood.
examples.notes: でできている = made of

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くに{大|おお}きな{公園|こうえん}ができて、{子供|こども}たちが{毎日|まいにち}{遊|あそ}んでいます。
examples.english: A large park was built nearby, and children play there every day.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xができる (X is possible/able).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. できている = 'is ready/completed' or 'is made of.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{日本語|にほんご}ができる (can speak Japanese)
・Vことができる (can do V)
・{準備|じゅんび}ができた (preparations are done)
・{木|き}でできている (made of wood)

Ability patterns: [noun]ができる (ability with noun); [V dict]ことができる (ability with verb).

Note: Subject takes が, not を.
